headline: Keep the distributed/local model, but stop treating broad fan-out as the primary success mechanism until exclusivity, telemetry and recursive ingestion are executable end to end.

executive_findings.finding: The canary produced real distributed value rather than only chat occupancy: all 52 statically READY lanes had exclusive normal claim paths at the stress snapshot, dynamic dependency activation passed, four local surface integrations later returned, and the recovered multi-surface candidate preserves four independent local planner/steward lanes under shared single-owner substrate.

Useful durable results per human intervention, global launch count, idle ratio and global collision rate are still UNKNOWN. The progress-metrics opportunity returned a deterministic contract but the suggested executable scripts/compile-progress-metrics.mjs is not present at this critic snapshot. Claim-path saturation cannot substitute for productivity evidence.

The stress verifier measured four overlapping recovery claims with one surviving return and three competing boundaries, so recovery ownership failed atomically. After that snapshot, portfolio fallback reproduced the same class of defect: at least two live unexpired claims for the exact same Student World bridge dedupe key were persisted eight seconds apart, and the directory contains multiple claim records. A derived portfolio-exclusive-job-pin repair is already active and must be consumed rather than duplicated.

The Planner canary proves deterministic G1 emission, two generated child lifecycles, zero human task wording between G1 and G2, and same-compiler G2 emission. The independent compounding verifier remains PARTIAL because the hardened integration-disposition ledger is bypassed, no executable deterministic source-builder derives G2/SOURCE from immutable returns plus validated dispositions, and the emitted G2 VERIFY is not executed into G3.

The recovered cross-surface integration satisfies its coordination-candidate contract, but all four public routes remain unresolved and the recovery explicitly claims no fresh Node run, browser/device E2E, Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion. Do not turn this coordination pass into a product-readiness claim.

CONTINUITY_HEAD.json explicitly remains MANUAL_SEED_UNTIL_COMPILER_EXISTS and was materially stale relative to live returns/recovery during this activation. A deduplicated proposal was pinned to build a deterministic candidate continuity-head compiler. This is not the production gate itself, but stale reconstruction cost scales badly with worker count.

architecture_comparison.description: Continue opening large numbers of identical workers whenever backlog exists, with global redistribution after races.
strengths: Static prepared allocation saturation was demonstrated.
Independent surface research and isolated candidate work parallelize well.
Dynamic successor activation occurred in live evidence.
weaknesses: Recovery and portfolio ownership races cause redundant attempts on mutable/exclusive work.
More workers amplify stale-state reconstruction and host-write collision pressure.

architecture_comparison.description: Retain independent per-surface planners/stewards and identical workers, but dispatch only from derived usefulFreeSlots/readiness through host-level atomic fences; make RETURN->validated disposition ledger->deterministic source builder->Planner the recursive spine; compile telemetry and continuity projections from durable evidence.
strengths: Matches the already-passing local-autonomy/multi-surface ownership model.
Preserves parallelism for independent lanes while reducing duplicate mutable work.
Closes the exact recursive and observability gaps identified by independent verifiers.
Makes scale a result of measured demand rather than a target worker count.
weaknesses: Requires host-integrated atomic ownership and instrumentation work before broad production use.
Needs an executable disposition/source-builder bridge and a stronger G2->G3 canary.

architecture_comparison.description: Collapse allocation/integration back into one long-lived central guide/worker to avoid concurrency races.
strengths: Simpler ownership and fewer write races.
weaknesses: Reintroduces the central bottleneck Prometeo is explicitly trying to remove.
Throws away demonstrated independent surface parallelism and local steward viability.
Makes context growth and chat loss more dangerous.

do_next_in_order.action: Only after those gates, re-evaluate production /w. Multi-surface coordination PASS alone is insufficient.

parallel_safe_now: per-surface local work with exclusive ownership
candidate continuity compiler work under isolated scope

stop_or_deprioritize: Stop using raw worker/chat count as a success target.
Stop interpreting 52/52 claim-path coverage as 52 useful completions or 10x productivity.
Do not launch additional broad mutable-work waves until host-level exclusivity is proven for every exclusive lane used by fallback/recovery.
Deprioritize new control-surface polish and additional surface breadth ahead of atomicity, executable metrics and recursive-ingestion closure.
Do not manually patch stale continuity fields as the primary long-term solution; compile a candidate projection from durable truth.
Do not promote /wc to production /w from the present evidence.

10x_assessment.why: The stress verifier explicitly lacks complete human-intervention, launch, idle and collision denominators. The compiler contract defines the required metric semantics but its executable implementation is not present at this snapshot.
evidence_needed: controlled baseline and scaled cohort comparison

production_w_effect: NO_PROMOTION; this critic satisfies the fresh-critic dependency artifact only. The separate production-readiness opportunity must still disposition the combined stress + integration + critic evidence.
